reasons: Corrected O1 shutters from false to true based on visible evidence in image 1.

Corrected the finishes to explicitly separate the lap siding on the main upper walls of V1 and V2 from the batten siding on the gables (G1, G2, G3) and the upper portion of V1 and V2 where the gables are. The prior analysis had a single 'upper' batten finish for the entire facade, which was inaccurate. The main upper walls of V1 and V2 are lap siding, while the gables and the upper parts of the volumes that form the gables are batten. This is now represented by multiple finish entries for the upper story.

The prior analysis's limitation regarding 'The exact material for the upper story gables (V1, G2, G3) is batten, while the main wall sections are lap siding. This is captured by the 'batten' finish entry for the upper story.' was contradictory and has been addressed by separating the finishes. The new limitation reflects only the metal awning.
The render image shows the same material distinctions as observed in the photos, confirming the need for separate finish entries for lap and batten siding on the upper story.
